    save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_comp_route value = $ROUTE$ }
    remove_variable = zg361_comp_runtime_applied
    set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_financial_applied value = 0 }

    if = {
        limit = {
            OR = {
                scope:zg361_comp_route = 1
                scope:zg361_comp_route = 2
                scope:zg361_comp_route = 3
            }
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_l_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_l_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_l_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_l_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_l_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_l_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_l_owner
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_l_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_l_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 1
            }
            has_variable = zg361_comp_m084_receipt_active
            var:zg361_comp_m084_receipt_active = 0

            trigger_if = {
                limit = { scope:zg361_comp_route = 1 }
                var:zg361_case_l_owner = { has_treasury = yes treasury >= 14 gold >= 6 }
                var:zg361_comp_l_treasury_available >= 14
                var:zg361_comp_l_personal_available >= 6
                var:zg361_comp_bonus_immediate_treasury_status = 0
                var:zg361_comp_bonus_immediate_personal_status = 0
                var:zg361_comp_bonus_deferred_treasury_status = 0
                var:zg361_comp_bonus_deferred_personal_status = 0
                var:zg361_comp_bonus_held_treasury_status = 0
                var:zg361_comp_bonus_held_personal_status = 0
            }
            trigger_else_if = {
                limit = { scope:zg361_comp_route = 2 }
                var:zg361_case_l_owner = { has_treasury = yes treasury >= 11 gold >= 5 }
                var:zg361_comp_l_treasury_available >= 11
                var:zg361_comp_l_personal_available >= 5
                var:zg361_comp_bonus_immediate_treasury_status = 0
                var:zg361_comp_bonus_immediate_personal_status = 0
                var:zg361_comp_bonus_deferred_treasury_status = 0
                var:zg361_comp_bonus_deferred_personal_status = 0
                var:zg361_comp_bonus_held_treasury_status = 0
                var:zg361_comp_bonus_held_personal_status = 0
            }
            trigger_else = { always = yes }
        }
        zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
            OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_l_owner
            SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_l_subject
            CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_l_cycle_serial
            CASE_VAR = zg361_case_l_case_serial
            STATE_VAR = zg361_case_l_state
            ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_l_active
            REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_l_revision
            TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_l_timeline_serial
            FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_l_feedback_revision
            LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_comp_l_last_operation
            LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_comp_l_last_route
            RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_comp_m084_receipt_owner
            RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_comp_m084_receipt_subject
            RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_comp_m084_receipt_cycle
            RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_comp_m084_receipt_case
            RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_comp_m084_receipt_state
            RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_comp_m084_receipt_route
            TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_l_owner
            TICKET_SUBJECT = this
            TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_l_cycle_serial
            TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_l_case_serial
            TICKET_STATE = 1
            CHOICE = scope:zg361_comp_route
            OPERATION_ID = 84
        }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_comp_route = 3 } }
                zg361_comp_l_reserve_bonus_effect = yes
            }
            else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_financial_applied value = 1 } }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    trigger_if = {
                        limit = { has_variable = zg361_comp_financial_applied }
                        var:zg361_comp_financial_applied = 1
                    }
                    trigger_else = { always = no }
                }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m084_receipt_active value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m084_route value = scope:zg361_comp_route }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m084_value value = 0 }
                if = { limit = { scope:zg361_comp_route = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m084_value value = 1 } }
                else_if = { limit = { scope:zg361_comp_route = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m084_value value = -1 } }
                zg361_comp_m084_consume_effect = yes
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_last_disposition value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_runtime_applied value = 1 }
            }
        }
    }
    else = {
        if = {
            limit = {
                var:zg361_comp_m084_receipt_active = 1
                var:zg361_comp_m084_receipt_owner = var:zg361_case_l_owner
                var:zg361_comp_m084_receipt_subject = this
                var:zg361_comp_m084_receipt_cycle = var:zg361_case_l_cycle_serial
                var:zg361_comp_m084_receipt_case = var:zg361_case_l_case_serial
                var:zg361_comp_m084_receipt_state = 1
            }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_comp_m084_receipt_route = scope:zg361_comp_route }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_last_disposition value = 2 }
            }
            else = {
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_typed_red value = 3 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_last_disposition value = -1 }
            }
        }
        else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_last_disposition value = 3 } }
    }
}

zg361_comp_m084_consume_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_l_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_l_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_l_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_l_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_l_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_l_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_l_owner
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_l_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_l_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 1
            }
            var:zg361_comp_m084_receipt_active = 1
            var:zg361_comp_m084_consumed = 0
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m084_object_materialized value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m084_object_owner value = var:zg361_case_l_owner }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m084_object_subject value = this }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m084_object_cycle value = var:zg361_case_l_cycle_serial }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m084_object_case value = var:zg361_case_l_case_serial }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m084_object_state value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m084_object_route value = var:zg361_comp_m084_route }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m084_visible_outcome value = var:zg361_comp_m084_route }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m084_visible_revision value = var:zg361_case_l_revision }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m084_formula_locked value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m084_reserve_receipt value = var:zg361_case_l_case_serial }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m084_frozen_total_reward value = var:zg361_comp_m082_total_reward }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m084_frozen_computed_bonus value = var:zg361_comp_m083_computed_bonus }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m084_frozen_gross value = var:zg361_comp_bonus_total }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m084_frozen_treasury value = var:zg361_comp_bonus_treasury_funded }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m084_frozen_personal value = var:zg361_comp_bonus_personal_funded }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m084_deferred_due_year value = { value = current_year add = 1 } }
            if = { limit = { var:zg361_comp_m084_route = 3 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m084_object_materialized value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m084_deferred_due_year value = 0 }
            }



        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m084_consumed value = 1 }
        if = {
            limit = {
                has_variable = zg361_pp_m147_receipt_active
                var:zg361_pp_m147_receipt_active = 1
                has_variable = zg361_pp_m147_consumed
                var:zg361_pp_m147_consumed = 1
                has_variable = zg361_pp_m147_receipt_owner
                var:zg361_pp_m147_receipt_owner = var:zg361_comp_result_owner
                has_variable = zg361_pp_m147_receipt_subject
                var:zg361_pp_m147_receipt_subject = var:zg361_comp_result_subject
                has_variable = zg361_pp_m147_receipt_cycle
                var:zg361_pp_m147_receipt_cycle = var:zg361_comp_result_cycle
                has_variable = zg361_pp_m147_receipt_serial
                var:zg361_pp_m147_receipt_serial = var:zg361_comp_result_case
                has_variable = zg361_pp_m147_receipt_revision
                var:zg361_pp_m147_receipt_revision > 0
                var:zg361_comp_m084_receipt_active = 1
                var:zg361_comp_m084_consumed = 1
                var:zg361_comp_m084_visible_revision > 0
            }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_promotion_receipt_active value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_promotion_receipt_posted value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_promotion_receipt_owner value = var:zg361_comp_result_owner }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_promotion_receipt_subject value = var:zg361_comp_result_subject }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_promotion_receipt_cycle value = var:zg361_comp_result_cycle }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_promotion_receipt_case value = var:zg361_comp_result_case }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_promotion_receipt_choice_serial value = var:zg361_pp_m147_receipt_serial }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_promotion_receipt_serial value = var:zg361_pp_m147_receipt_serial }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_promotion_receipt_choice_revision value = var:zg361_pp_m147_receipt_revision }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_promotion_receipt_revision value = var:zg361_comp_m084_visible_revision }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_promotion_receipt_operation value = 84 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_promotion_receipt_route value = var:zg361_comp_m084_receipt_route }
        }
        zg361_comp_l_try_advance_01_effect = yes
        debug_log = "ZG361COMP: consumed mechanism 084"
    }
}
